features.name: Reference search across recorder history
features.description: Search the owner's full history by order/shipment reference with existing filters and pagination. Document exact/partial, case and whitespace matching semantics during implementation. See docs/MOBILE_LOCALIZATION_DRIVE_PLAN.md.
acceptance_criteria: Search runs server-side across owned records, composes with filters and resets pagination when changed or cleared.
Empty/loading/error states are localized and references retain their original stored values.
Additive query contract, matching edge cases, bounded queries and owner isolation are documented and verified across backend/client.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Added bounded reference query to owner-scoped activity history, literal case-insensitive substring matching before count/pagination, trimmed query edges and preserved reference values. UI provides localized search/clear/help/error states, composes with filters, resets page on apply/clear and preserves search across paging/language switches. Fixed cancelled list schema to match the existing UI/domain contract. Startup ./init.sh passed; web 38/38 plus typecheck/build, backend 80 passed/5 opt-in skipped plus typecheck/build, PostgreSQL recorder integrations 2/2 with temporary fixture cleanup. Integration proves literal special characters, quote safety, both providers, null references, owner isolation, deleted exclusion, date/status filters and page boundaries. Browser discovery returned []; physical mobile/visual QA unavailable. No migration/environment changes; current local web 5173 and backend 3000 remain running.

features.name: Compare packing and unpacking evidence by reference
features.description: Let owners select packing and unpacking records with the same reference for manual evidence comparison on phone and larger screens. See docs/MOBILE_LOCALIZATION_DRIVE_PLAN.md.
acceptance_criteria: Show selectable packing/unpacking records and their media, times and notes with phone tabs/sections and suitable wider layouts.
Handle a missing side or multiple records for one reference without assuming uniqueness or automatically pairing unrelated records.
Reuse owner-authorized viewing; verify both locales, multiple/missing matches and access isolation. No automated damage analysis.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Added authenticated exact-reference comparison candidates bounded to the newest 50 records per operation, owner/tombstone isolation, explicit selection for multiple matches, one-match convenience, missing-side/truncation/error states, phone tabs, wide two-column evidence, notes/times/status/media and protected original downloads in VI/EN. No pair is persisted and no automatic/AI assessment occurs. Startup/final ./init.sh passed; web 42/42 plus typecheck/build, backend 83 passed/5 opt-in skipped plus typecheck/build, PostgreSQL recorder integrations 2/2 with fixtures cleaned, harness 100/100 and API JSON examples valid. Browser runtime had no available instances, so physical mobile/wide visual QA remains documented and unavailable. No migration, environment or provider change.

features.name: Recover server-created unfinished recorder activities
features.description: Resume draft/uploading activities after reload or interruption by reconciling server assets, preserving ready files and reselecting missing local files when required. See docs/MOBILE_LOCALIZATION_DRIVE_PLAN.md.
acceptance_criteria: An unfinished-work view reopens the same server-created activity and reconciles server state before retries without duplicating ready assets.
Missing files can be reselected only after identity/content validation; expired attempts, sessions and provider permissions have clear recovery.
Preserve each activity's provider regardless of new-record defaults and honor completion/cancellation/deletion invariants.
Verify interrupted create/upload/finalize responses and reload recovery for B2 and Drive; background uploads, byte-level resume and durable offline videos are not promised.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Added the unfinished-work view to Evidence archive, loading owner-scoped draft/uploading activities after reload, preserving the activity storage provider and ready assets, and reopening detail without creating a new activity. Missing assets require an exact filename/content-type/size/SHA-256 match before retry; retries reuse the same asset and finalize the newly issued attempt, with active-attempt, provider/network and generic recovery errors kept visible. Added a custom Delete unfinished activity action that invokes the existing cancellation/cleanup lifecycle and removes the item from the recovery list after success. Added VI/EN strings and component coverage for ready retention, wrong-file rejection and same-asset retry. Verification: ./init.sh passed; web 44/44 plus typecheck/build. Backend contract is unchanged and existing retry/finalize/cancel invariants are reused. Browser runtime discovery returned []; physical mobile/provider visual QA remains unavailable and documented. No migration, environment or provider changes.

features.name: Explain personal Google Drive storage after sign-in
features.description: After application login, clearly explain that connecting Google Drive gives the operator a personal storage destination, with a visible connect/manage path and status that does not confuse app authentication with Google authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Signed-in users can understand why connecting Google Drive is useful before starting a record, without being forced to connect it.
The UI distinguishes application sign-in from Google Drive connection and shows connected, unavailable, reconnect and not-configured states with a direct action.
Existing provider choice, activity provider pinning and VI/EN behavior remain unchanged; no OAuth scope or credential contract change is implied.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Signed-in workspace presents a personal-storage setup panel only while Google Drive is not connected; once connected the panel hides, while existing connection management remains in the profile menu. Copy distinguishes app sign-in from Google authorization, keeps Google optional and offers application storage as an alternative. Unlink/provider-change events make the panel eligible to reappear. VI/EN copy added; OAuth scope, credentials, provider pinning and API contract are unchanged. Verification: ./init.sh passed; web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed.

features.name: Use product-facing storage labels
features.description: Replace infrastructure-specific Backblaze B2 wording in user-facing surfaces with a product-facing application storage label while preserving technical provider identifiers in APIs and diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: User-facing storage choices, badges, errors and activity details use a neutral label such as Application storage / Bộ nhớ ứng dụng.
Google Drive remains named because the user must recognize the external account and permission boundary.
Stored provider enums, API payloads, logs and operational documentation retain their technical identifiers; both locales and existing tests are updated together.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Replaced user-facing Backblaze B2 wording across the workspace hero, recorder provider badge/select, history detail, comparison and unfinished-recovery surfaces with neutral Application storage / Bộ nhớ ứng dụng labels. Removed the Refresh storage and Manage Google Drive buttons from New Record's Storage area; status refresh remains automatic and connection management stays in the signed-in storage/profile surfaces. Google Drive remains named for account and permission clarity; API enums, backend provider identifiers, logs and storage behavior are unchanged. Web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed.

features.name: Reset form and present submitted evidence
features.description: After a record is successfully completed, reset the new-record inputs and present a reviewable preview of the evidence that was just submitted, while retaining the secured record in history.
acceptance_criteria: Successful completion clears editable metadata and file-selection state so the next record starts cleanly.
The success state presents the submitted record reference and verified evidence preview, including image/video behavior and a link to the protected detail/history view.
Reset happens only after completion succeeds; upload/finalize failures preserve recovery state and do not discard selected evidence.
VI/EN, keyboard focus, object-URL cleanup and mobile layout are covered without changing completion invariants or making storage public.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Successful completion now snapshots the verified local evidence for a centered success modal, clears activity metadata/file-selection state and resets the form so the next record starts clean. The modal shows the submitted reference, verified/secured status, image/video previews and Start another record; upload/finalize failures retain the existing recovery state. Added coverage for reset reference and retained preview. Verification: ./init.sh baseline passed; web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed. No backend contract, migration or storage visibility change.

features.name: Custom confirmation dialogs
features.description: Replace browser-default confirmation prompts for destructive recorder actions with accessible application dialogs.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel and delete activity confirmations use the product modal style with explicit confirm and keep actions.
Dialogs expose role, modal semantics and localized copy; dismissing keeps the activity unchanged.
OS file chooser UI remains external to the web app and is not reimplemented.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Replaced window.confirm for recorder cancel/delete actions with an accessible VI/EN application dialog. Web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed.

features.name: Custom application dropdowns
features.description: Replace native browser select popups in recorder and comparison forms with an application-owned accessible listbox.
acceptance_criteria: Storage, operation, status, order and comparison record choices open an application-owned listbox instead of a native dropdown.
Choices preserve form values and disabled options, with keyboard open/close support and localized labels.
No API enum or form submission contract changes.
features.evidence: Completed 2026-09-17. Replaced the shared Select primitive with a custom listbox popover while retaining a synchronized form select for compatibility. Added keyboard Enter/Space/ArrowDown/Escape behavior and preserved disabled options and values. Web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed.

features.name: Refresh product identity for packing and unpacking
features.description: Replace the narrow UnboxProof and legacy Shopping Recorder user-facing identity with a modern brand that clearly covers both packing and unpacking evidence.
acceptance_criteria: The header mark, document title, metadata, footer and legal pages use one consistent product name.
The name and supporting copy clearly cover both packing and unpacking workflows in English and Vietnamese.
Technical routes, API identifiers, storage providers and deployment URLs remain unchanged.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-21 after visual feedback. Kept PackTrace and the package/arrows concept, then tuned the icon to a high-contrast lavender background with indigo package lines, navy structure and lime return arrow. Verification: web 44/44 tests, typecheck and build passed; feature_list.json remains valid.

features.name: Thirty-day evidence retention and logo refresh
features.description: Automatically expire completed recorder evidence 30 days after completion, delete provider objects while preserving record metadata with an expired status, and reload the browser page when the PackTrace logo is activated.
acceptance_criteria: A completed activity receives a deterministic evidence expiry time 30 days after completion; a background sweep marks due records expired before attempting provider deletion.
Expired records remain owner-visible and filterable, retain metadata and audit history, deny evidence retrieval, and clearly communicate that stored evidence has expired.
Provider cleanup uses the existing exact-object cleanup mechanism and failed deletions remain retryable without restoring evidence access.
Activating the PackTrace logo performs a full page reload and remains keyboard-accessible.
Migration, API contract, operations documentation, focused backend/web tests, type checks, builds, progress and handoff evidence are updated together.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-21. Added migration 0011 with a completedAt + 30-day evidence deadline, expired lifecycle state/timestamps/audit and due index; startup/hourly backend sweeping revokes access before exact-provider cleanup and retries pending failures while preserving owner-visible metadata. Updated API/domain/docs and VI/EN archive/comparison UI so expired evidence has no preview/download controls. PackTrace logo is now an accessible full-page reload button. Migration applied locally; PostgreSQL integrations 4/4 passed; backend 85 passed/5 opt-in skipped plus typecheck/build; web 46/46 plus typecheck/build; harness 100/100; final ./init.sh passed. No live provider object was intentionally aged/deleted; provider deletion is covered through deterministic adapter tests and existing live provider behavior.

features.name: Reliable direct camera capture uploads
features.description: Fix image and video uploads created through mobile camera capture so they use supported media metadata and preserve the selected storage provider and recovery state on failure.
acceptance_criteria: Photos and videos captured from the device camera pass client validation and upload through the same provider-safe workflow as selected files.
Browser-specific empty or generic capture MIME metadata is normalized only when the filename safely identifies an allowed media type; unsupported files remain rejected.
Focused tests cover captured image/video metadata, provider-appropriate errors and unchanged record/provider recovery behavior.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-22. Raised the authenticated Drive proxy route body limit from Fastify's 1 MiB default to the configured maximum media size, while retaining exact Content-Length and asset-size checks. Camera files with empty or generic MIME metadata are normalized only from allow-listed filename extensions and retain correct image/video preview and create-asset metadata. Focused Drive tests 15/15 and RecorderWorkflow tests 17/17 passed; backend/web typecheck and production builds passed. Live physical-device capture remains a documented manual check.

features.name: Mobile account popup containment and dismissal
features.description: Keep Vietnamese reconnect/change-account actions inside the account popup on narrow screens and dismiss the popup when tapping outside it.
acceptance_criteria: Long Vietnamese account actions wrap or size within the viewport without overflowing the popup.
Tapping or clicking outside the popup dismisses it while interactions inside remain usable.
Keyboard and accessible popup behavior remain covered in VI and EN.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-22. The profile popup is capped to the phone viewport, long Vietnamese Drive actions wrap within their buttons, and confirmation actions wrap when needed. Document pointer dismissal closes only outside taps/clicks; Escape closes and restores trigger focus. AccountAccess and GoogleDriveConnection focused tests 7/7 passed; web typecheck passed.

features.name: Compact mobile record form
features.description: Reorganize mobile text inputs and selectors so core record fields and evidence actions require substantially less vertical scrolling without changing submitted values.
acceptance_criteria: Phone layouts surface operation, reference, notes, storage and evidence controls in a compact, understandable order.
Text inputs and application selectors retain labels, touch targets, validation and VI/EN behavior.
Desktop layout and API payload behavior remain unchanged.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-22. Phone layout now hides nonessential recorder intro/help copy, places storage and operation in a two-column field grid, keeps reference and notes full-width, shortens the notes/drop zone, and reduces section/footer spacing; sm/desktop sizing and all form names/payloads remain intact. RecorderWorkflow focused tests 18/18, web typecheck and production build passed. Browser discovery returned no available browser, so physical phone visual verification remains manual.

features.name: Centered evidence detail modal
features.description: Open selected evidence-record details in a centered responsive modal instead of appending the detail below the record list.
acceptance_criteria: Viewing a record opens its metadata, lifecycle actions and evidence in a centered responsive dialog above the archive.
The dialog supports explicit close and outside dismissal without losing archive filters or pagination.
Evidence viewer nesting, focus/accessibility semantics and phone scrolling remain usable.
features.evidence: Completed on 2026-09-22. Activity detail loading, errors, metadata actions and evidence now render in a centered, viewport-bounded modal with internal phone scrolling and body scroll lock. Explicit close, outside pointer dismissal and Escape restore the list trigger while filters/pagination remain mounted; nested confirmation and evidence viewer overlays use a higher layer. RecorderHistory focused tests 7/7, web typecheck and production build passed. Browser discovery returned no available browser, so physical phone visual verification remains manual.
